title: Basic Cover Letter Review
desc: Professional review of your existing cover letter with actionable line-by-line feedback.

faqs.q: What do I need to submit?
faqs.a: You need to submit your current resume, existing cover letter, and a link to the job description you are targeting.

faqs.q: Can you rewrite it for me?
faqs.a: This service is for review and feedback only. For a complete rewrite, please select our Professional or Executive options.
